metadata.title: Disco Era Portrait with Neon Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered glamour portrait featuring voluminous dark hair against a blue gradient, paired with top-left aligned neon pink script and a secondary street scene vignette.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a woman with large, textured dark hair, positioned in the foreground against a vibrant blue gradient. In the upper left, a glowing neon pink script title sits above a smaller sans-serif subtitle. A soft-focus vignette in the mid-ground shows a street lamp and two figures, creating a narrative layer within the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground portrait dominates the right and center frame
Neon typography balances the composition in the upper left
Street lamp vignette provides a conceptual anchor on the left
Blue background provides a cool contrast to warm skin tones and pink neon
coreInvariants: Voluminous, dark, textured hair as a primary silhouette
Neon pink glow effect on all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is a medium-close-up portrait, slightly off-center to the right, filling approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the glowing pink street lamp serve as dual focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large portrait, move to the glowing neon text in the top left, then down to the street lamp vignette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue gradient background provides breathing room around the complex hair texture and the secondary vignette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black hair and lace clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink for typography and lamp glow
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and pinks; high value contrast between the dark hair and the bright background.

letterConstructionRules: Script features a double-line 'inline' or 'neon tube' effect
Fluid, connected strokes with rounded terminals
Secondary text is wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'D' and 'S' feature exaggerated, looping flourishes
The 'B' and 'G' in the subtitle are perfectly circular in their curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, organic script paired with rigid, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif for a high-low contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the double-line tube aesthetic of the primary title
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 70s-style curly dark hair against a blue radial gradient background. Include a small, soft-focus vignette on the left showing a glowing pink street lamp and two small figures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom neon pink double-line script text in the top left corner, with a wide-spaced geometric sans-serif subtitle directly underneath, both featuring a soft pink outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the hair voluminous and textured?
Does the blue background have a radial gradient?
Is the typography neon pink with a glow?
Is the subtitle wide-tracked and all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Position of the street lamp vignette
mustRedesign: Any specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the original title
Specific clothing details that are brand-identifiable

avoid: Generic cursive fonts without neon styling

postGenerationChecks: Check that the neon text is legible against the blue background
Ensure the street lamp glow matches the typography color
Verify the hair silhouette is the dominant shape
Confirm the wide tracking on the subtitle is preserved
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait Subject (Voluminous Hair) + Blue Gradient Backdrop + Neon Script (Top Left) + Narrative Vignette (Mid-ground Left) = Disco Glamour Aesthetic
